en.title: Review application security
en.description: Review supported Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Go code against security guidance.
tasks: Review supported Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Go code against security guidance.
prerequisites: Read access to an authorized codebase and its framework/configuration files.
en.example: Use security-best-practices. Review this API’s authentication and input handling, citing file locations and prioritizing fixes.
en.expectedResult: A scoped findings report with evidence, severity, and concrete remediation.
limitations: A guided review is not a penetration test or a guarantee that all vulnerabilities are found.

zh.title: 检查应用安全实践
zh.description: 依据安全指南检查 Python、JavaScript/TypeScript 与 Go 代码。
tasks: 依据安全指南检查 Python、JavaScript/TypeScript 与 Go 代码。
prerequisites: 获授权代码库及框架、配置文件的读取权限。
zh.example: 请使用 security-best-practices：检查此 API 的鉴权和输入处理，标注代码位置并排列修复优先级。
zh.expectedResult: 包含范围、证据、严重程度和具体修复建议的报告。
limitations: 此流程不等于渗透测试，也不保证发现所有漏洞。
